comments:
a0d7c4f5:  ;
 ;This is the main driver of the program. It sets the required variables,
 ;checks if it needs to sort the procedures, retrieves the patient dates,
 ;prompts the user for certain parameters, formats the output, and then
 ;initiates the report.
e0e695b7: ;If dividing procedures, do it before anything else.
6a569145: ;Else retrieve next print number for the deficiency report.
14dee6d6: ;Sets variables and other parameters required for running the report.
a2229520: ;Retrieves the patients' dates.
f491aeee: ;Prompts user for additional parameters for the report.
b482214a: ;Prompts user for additional parameters.
59185a38: ;Warns user that 132 column output is required for this report.
d75e20aa: ;Gets current date/time formatted for the report header.
a3367fcd: ;Sets variables required to run the report, prompts for device, and queues it.
b873b918: ;End of routine.
b4043d24: Start processing records in the 'VAS' file.
290ba0f9: If the user selected the options 1 or 3, and there are records in the temporary storage, reset the variables and go to the DGJPDEF2 routine.
5c72aca2: If the user selected option 2, and there are records in the temporary storage, reset the variables and go to the DGJPDEF3 routine.
cbc61bb6: If there are no records in the temporary storage, display a message saying 'NO RECORDS'.
43c20438: Exit the current routine and go to the QUIT^DGJPDEF routine.

31da0e83:  ;
 ;Set values for Service Entry point information
 ;
 ;DGJT       = Patient Event pointer
 ;CA         = Case assignment for this Patient Event
 ;DGJTQF     = Flag to quit if there is an error
 ;DGJTDIV    = Division pointer for this Patient Event
 ;DGJTWARD   = Ward pointer for this Patient Event
 ;DGJTSV     = Service pointer for assigned Ward
 ;DGJTP      = Division 'Software Install Pat' Date/Time
58349935: ;Get DGJT pointer or last CA. Quit if no DGJT pointer
c7b3bedb: ;Get DGJTWARD and DGJTDIV for DGJT pointer
1c1d35b4: ;Get ward and division for DGJT
ea992790: ;Set DGJTDIV from DGJTWARD
b08e3e20: ;Get division 'Software Install Pat' Date/Time
db7b8c3d: ;Set DGJTSV equal to Service pointer based on DGJTWARD and check if DGJTSV is a valid division service. If not, set DGJTQF (flag to quit due to error)
8a9920f2: If the patient has no DG ACTION CODE set, retrieve the next available ACTION CODE.
e870a2be: Check and display the SPECIALTY associated with the DG ACTION CODE.
7120bf4a: End of routine.
ab1e46ba: Quit if the 6th piece of DGJTNODE is blank and VAUTD is not defined, or if VAUTD is defined and does not contain the entry number contained in the 6th piece of DGJTNODE.
3b4276b3: If DGJTDV is defined and the 6th piece of DGJTNODE is non-blank, quit if they do not match.

6cbd2e5b: If the 3rd piece of the DT field in file 40.8 for the entry number in the 6th piece of DGJTNODE is 0 and the 2nd piece of DGJTNODE matches the IEN for 'SIGNED NO REVIEW' in file 393.2, kill X1, X2, X3 and quit.

c8af8d7c: If the 3rd piece of the DT field in file 40.8 for the entry number in the 6th piece of DGJTNODE is 1 and the 2nd piece of DGJTNODE matches the IEN for 'REVIEWED' in file 393.2, kill X1, X2, X3 and quit.
c3d11362: If the 2nd piece of DGJTNODE matches the IEN for 'COMPLETED' in file 393.2, kill X1, X2, X3 and quit.
f103b66b: Kill the variables X1, X2, and X3.
4fa95cc0: If DGJTSR1 is 1 and the 4th piece of DGJTNODE is null, quit.
c5945b5a: If DGJTSR1 is 2 and the 4th piece of DGJTNODE is not null, quit.
16eb8d53: If the VAUTY array exists, and VAUTY is false, and there is no node in VAUTY with the 2nd piece of DGJTNODE as the subscript, quit.
d1c90f6a: Quit if the date of the node is outside the date range.
fe374bad: For processing patients, if the patient is a provider and the provider is not a team member, quit.
71900f58: For processing providers, if the provider is not a team member, quit.
5e27c8ac: If the service record is a summary, do not process the node.
7925b223: ;Initialize accumulator for division total claims.
445a7f97: ;Get patient name and DFN from node.
14e1f7d3: ;If list type is PHY store in temporary global subscripted by division, physician, patient, claim date/time and IFN.

51f45ebc: If the DGJTL variable is 'PAT', set DGJTPHY to the primary provider name and provider code from the DGJTNODE variable. Then, store the patient DFN in the ^TMP global, using the job number, visit number, patient ID, visit date/time, provider name and code, and internal entry number (IFN) as subscripts.
37c41a38: ;For serology, set the Test value and Provider values.
c6f684ec: ;Set Test value in external format and IEN format.
6a543a6e: ;Set Provider value in external format and IEN format.
6816afd1: ;If QF (Quick Filter) is set, do not process.
76819843: ;For serology, store patient and test/provider info in ^TMP.
4d179b34: ;End of routine.
55d85e0d: ;Set up variables for provider lookup, and call the FIRST^VAUTOMA API to prompt for a provider. If no provider is selected, set DGJFL flag to 1.
7f679d24: ;Exit the PHY routine (presumably called from another routine).
941c9c71: ;Call the PATIENT^VAUTOMA API to prompt for a patient.
67f1e7bc: ;Exit the PAT routine (presumably called from another routine).
a28d0375: ;Set up variables for service lookup, and call the FIRST^VAUTOMA API to prompt for a service. If no service is selected, exit the routine.
d5756d9a: ;Set up variables for specialty lookup, and call the FIRST^VAUTOMA API to prompt for a specialty.
4c17556f: ;Exit the SER routine (presumably called from another routine).
